title: release-train-weekly-prep-notes-2026-03-04
body:
Release train weekly prep notes — 2026-03-04
Owner: Noah Kim (notes + facilitation)
Status: in_review (will sync with Priya + SRE before go/no-go)
Attendees (expected): Priya K, Samir P, Aisha R, Evan R, Luke W (on-call), infra lead (TBD)

Meeting goals:
- Quick readiness check across infra, DB migrations, canary metrics, client docs, and feature flags
- Identify blockers and assign owners for go/no-go decision
- Confirm rollback plan and post-launch monitoring owners

Agenda (30m)
1) Quick status round (5m) — each owner gives one line (green/yellow/red)
2) Checklist walkthrough (15m) — call out blockers and timing
3) Rollback + post-launch ops (5m)
4) Actions & next steps (5m)

Readiness checklist (owner — status — notes)
- Infra capacity verification — Priya Kapoor — green — dedicated pool scaled to expected QPS; validated perf test @ 80% load
- Gateway + routing policies reviewed — Samir Patel — green — fallback routes configured between hosted/dedicated
- Model artifacts pinned + checksum verified — Aisha Rahman — green — model v2.3 pinned, quantized artifact verified locally
- DB migration (non-backwards compatible) — Evan Ramirez — yellow (blocked) — final migration script needs runbook update; scheduled 2026-03-05 02:00 UTC; backup window confirmed but runbook missing step 4 (owner: Evan)
- Feature flag gating & kill-switch — Noah Kim — green — flags created, preflight test pass on staging; need PROD rollout plan doc link in Confluence (action)
- Canary plan + service-level metrics — Luke Wu — yellow — canary thresholds defined but alerting playbook not linked to PagerDuty escalation (action: Luke)
- Client docs + release notes — Product (Priya) — yellow — release notes draft ready; SDK changelog needs small snippet for streaming API change (owner: DevRel)
- Compliance / audit artifacts — Security — green — KMS keys validated; audit logs retention verified
- E2E QA signoff — QA (Aisha) — red (blocked) — 3 failing testcases on rate-limiter config; root cause suspected in infra config, tracking in RTR-3421 (Evan + Infra)

Open risks / blocking items
- E2E QA failing tests (priority) — blocks go/no-go until passing or mitigated; workaround: temporary throttle change in gateway (risk: increased latency for some customers). Owner: Aisha + Evan aiming to triage by 03-04 EOD.
- DB migration runbook incomplete — MUST be finalized before 02:00 UTC migration. Owner: Evan.
- PagerDuty escalation not wired to canary alerts — risk for post-launch detection. Owner: Luke to complete by 03-05 10:00 UTC.

Rollback plan (short)
- Immediate: flip feature flag (kill-switch) — owners: Noah / Priya
- Short-term: route traffic to previous model variant in dedicated pool — Samir
- DB: if migration fails during deploy, stop rollout and restore from pre-migration snapshot (playbook entry 7). Owner: Evan

Pre-launch smoke (to run 30m before go)
- Run smoke suite against staging release (QA) — Aisha
- Validate canary metrics baseline (last 48h) — Luke
- Confirm backup snapshot integrity (DB) — Evan
- Notify SRE rotation / on-call — Samir

Decision criteria for go/no-go
- All critical blockers resolved or mitigated (E2E QA or documented mitigation)
- DB migration runbook complete + dry-run on staging
- Canary alerts wired to PagerDuty
- Docs + release notes published at least 1 hour before launch

Action items (owner — due)
- Aisha: triage failing E2E tests + list top-3 flakes (due 2026-03-04 EOD)
- Evan: finish DB migration runbook + add step for abort/restore (due 2026-03-04 22:00 UTC)
- Luke: wire canary alerts to PagerDuty + add escalation steps to Confluence (due 2026-03-05 10:00 UTC)
- Noah: add PROD rollout plan link to Confluence + post release communication draft (due 2026-03-04 18:00 UTC)
- Priya: finalize client SDK changelog snippet & publish release notes draft (due 2026-03-04 16:00 UTC)
- Samir: validate rollback routing test in staging and confirm metric tags (due 2026-03-05 00:00 UTC)

Notes / things to remember (personal scratchpad)
- If E2E can't be fixed, consider a phased rollout: small customer segment first (10%) for 24h with close SRE watch.
- Keep PM/CS on standby to handle any customer escalations (Priya to notify CS lead).
- Double-check HSM/KMS keys rotation window to avoid interfering with launch window

Meeting prep checklist (what I need to bring)
- Latest E2E test failure logs (link: RTR-3421)
- Migration runbook draft (Evan)
- Canary metric screenshots and thresholds
- Release notes link + SDK snippet

Tentative timeline
- 03-04: final prep + triage
- 03-05 02:00 UTC: DB migration (if all green)
- 03-05 03:30-04:00 UTC: rollout starts (canary)
- 03-05 06:00 UTC: evaluate canary, ramp to 50% if healthy

Notes to self: keep the meeting tight — 30m max. Prioritize blockers; if DB migration runbook not ready, NO GO. Bring concrete mitigation options to meeting.

-- End of notes --
